title: Kenya road network (OpenStreetMap / Geofabrik)
description: Road network extracted from the Geofabrik Kenya OSM extract, for road exposure to flooding.

transfer.rationale: Re-run the ingest against its public origin rather than copying; the ingest is the definition of the dataset.

gaps: OSM is a rolling snapshot with no version pin; the ingest records the download date only.

changelog.change: Record created; back-filled from the existing CDH record and ingest script.
